summary: Iteration 5 verifies real RevenueCat SDK wiring (purchases-js Test Store on web preview). Backend regression: full pytest suite green — 31/31 pass in 10.6s (auth, PATCH /auth/me, recipes, likes/saves/history, subscription, AI + save-generated + numeric coercion, meal-plan CRUD + gating, prefs incl. cuisines+skill_level). No backend changes this iteration. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport, deployed URL): app boots to /auth/welcome, no red 'Purchases unavailable' banner ever appears (pre- or post-login on cook@owami.app). Console shows real RC SDK init: 'Web platform detected. Using RevenueCat in Browser Mode' + 'Initializing Purchases SDK with RC Test store API Key' — the try/catch at _layout.tsx swallows nothing (no crash, actual init succeeds). Paywall (/paywall) renders hero 'Cook smarter with Owami+', full 6-item feature list, close (paywall-close), subscribe (paywall-subscribe), restore (paywall-restore), Terms/Privacy links, and REAL offerings loaded from RevenueCat: paywall-option-$rc_monthly ('Pro monthly · $9.99 · monthly') and paywall-option-$rc_annual ('Pro annual · Best value · $15.99 · annual'). Empty-state fallback did NOT render (good — offerings loaded). Restore button tap did not crash the paywall. Profile subscription section (free user cook@owami.app): row-upgrade + row-restore present, row-manage-sub absent — correct. Premium gates: on cook@owami.app tapping /create/from-ingredients Generate button shows label 'Unlock with Owami+' and navigates to /paywall (does NOT hit /ai/from-ingredients). After sign-in as premium@owami.app, Generate label reads 'Cook something up' and /meal-plan shows the 7-day grid with mealplan-add-* slots (no upgrade card). Meal-plan gating unchanged from prior iteration. ONE flow could not be verified end-to-end: tapping paywall-subscribe did NOT open the paywall-confirm-cancel / paywall-confirm-purchase modal — see rca_of_issue below.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping paywall-subscribe on web preview did not open the confirm modal (paywall-confirm-cancel / paywall-confirm-purchase). Root cause: onPurchase() short-circuits when !identityReady, and after a fresh navigation to /paywall the RC SDK's originalAppUserId still reports `$RCAnonymousID:...` (confirmed via console) — the async Purchases.logIn(user.id) from RevenueCatIdentityBinder hadn't completed / been reflected in getCustomerInfo cache yet, so identityReady stayed false and the tap silently no-op'd (no visible error text appeared either because the tap raced ahead of setErr). Reproduction: sign in as cook@owami.app → open /paywall → within ~5 s tap paywall-option-$rc_monthly then paywall-subscribe → confirm modal never appears. Reference: /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:52-57 and /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx:63-68,76.

integration_issues.issue: RevenueCatIdentityBinder calls bindRevenueCatIdentity(user.id) → Purchases.logIn(userId), but the customer-info React-Query cache is not invalidated afterwards, so useSubscription().identityReady lags until the 60 s staleTime refetch (or a manual refresh). This is what caused the confirm-modal miss above.

action_items: In bindRevenueCatIdentity() (or in the identity binder's useEffect), after Purchases.logIn(userId) resolves, invalidate the ['revenuecat','customer-info'] query so identityReady flips to true immediately — otherwise the paywall subscribe button is silently disabled/no-op for up to 60 s after fresh sign-in on web. Suggested tweak: expose a queryClient.invalidateQueries call from SubscriptionProvider or setQueryData with the returned CustomerInfo. Alternative: also gate onPurchase() on a short retry (e.g. call await Purchases.getCustomerInfo() once inside onPurchase before opening the confirm modal).

Optional: when identityReady is false, either disable the paywall-subscribe button with a visible tooltip/toast, or show the setErr message immediately on tap (current onPurchase does setErr but it may race with fast taps). Either fix makes the failure mode obvious to the user.

Optional (pre-existing, iter-4 note still open): profile.tsx has both a new row-preferences ('Cooking preferences') and an unwired row-diet ('Dietary preferences'). Consider removing row-diet or wiring it to /onboarding?from=settings for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: revenuecat.tsx correctly uses TEST_API_KEY on web + __DEV__ and IOS/ANDROID keys elsewhere. rcEnabled gates all SDK calls. Missing keys throw only inside getRevenueCatApiKey which is wrapped by the try/catch in _layout.tsx — safe.

initializeRevenueCat() is idempotent via _initialized flag — good. Module-scope init inside try/catch means preview never crashes if react-native-purchases web shim misbehaves. Verified: app booted cleanly and RC init logs show success on web.

paywall.tsx: coded fallback correctly renders paywall-option-* from currentOffering.availablePackages. Empty-state box (not a fake buy button) is shown when packages.length===0 — verified by inspection. Best-value badge shown for ANNUAL package. priceString comes straight from RC product — verified: $9.99 / $15.99 rendered.
Gates in create/from-ingredients.tsx and meal-plan.tsx correctly OR useSubscription().isSubscribed with user?.is_premium — verified free routes to /paywall and premium proceeds.
revenuecat-identity-binder.tsx: swallows non-null err into a state banner, and rendered null on happy path (no banner shown in tests). Good.

Minor: SubscriptionProvider wraps children with a hook that uses useQuery — since offeringsQuery has staleTime 300s and customerInfoQuery 60s, identityReady updates lag after Purchases.logIn(). Consider setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], info) inside bindRevenueCatIdentity after logIn returns (Purchases.logIn resolves with { customerInfo, created }).
app/_layout.tsx correctly places SubscriptionProvider inside AuthProvider so identity binder can read user, and above <Stack /> so all screens can useSubscription().

rca_of_issue:
BUG: paywall confirm modal fails to open after tapping paywall-subscribe when the user just signed in.
REPRO: (1) fresh session → welcome-signin-button → login as cook@owami.app → wait for /home → open /paywall → click paywall-option-$rc_monthly → click paywall-subscribe within ~5s of paywall mount.
OBSERVED: no modal, no visible error, subscribe tap is a no-op. Console still shows app_user_id starts with '$RCAnonymousID:'.
ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx line 54 gates onPurchase on identityReady (`if (!identityReady) { setErr('Sign in first...'); return; }`). identityReady is derived in /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx from customerInfoQuery.data.originalAppUserId. The React-Query for customer-info was populated once at SubscriptionProvider mount (anonymous ID). RevenueCatIdentityBinder subsequently calls Purchases.logIn(user.id), but nothing invalidates the ['revenuecat','customer-info'] queryKey → identityReady stays false until the next refetch (60s staleTime) or a customer-info listener event fires.
MITIGATION (fix at source): in bindRevenueCatIdentity() (/app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx:114), capture the return of `await Purchases.logIn(userId)` (which is `{ customerInfo, created }`) and either (a) queryClient.setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], customerInfo) — requires access to queryClient — or (b) invalidateQueries. Cleanest: move bind logic into SubscriptionProvider so it can access queryClient directly, or export a setCustomerInfo helper. As a defensive belt-and-braces, also inside paywall.tsx onPurchase() do `const info = await Purchases.getCustomerInfo();` and re-check the originalAppUserId before short-circuiting.
